name: Scanner_Audio_Feedback
description: Audio design for the scanner: activation sound, scanning beam hum/whine, domain-specific result chimes, error/no-detection feedback, and ambient audio integration.

questions.question: Do the scan audio cues reinforce learning (distinct tones for geology/minerals/weather/stars)?
questions.answer: This feature teaches real science through gameplay — the core educational mechanic.

questions.question: Is the scanner sound (rising-pitch sweep + domain chime) memorable enough for a TikTok sound bite?
questions.answer: This feature generates shareable moments and press coverage. Differentiator from competitors.

questions.question: Does the scanner audio sound like a real scientific instrument (spectrometer, LIDAR, Geiger counter references)?
questions.answer: This feature makes the universe feel real and alive through physical accuracy.

questions.question: Can the audio be implemented with UE5.8 MetaSounds without requiring Wwise or FMOD licensing?
questions.answer: Can be implemented with existing UE5 tools and Python modules. No pipeline blockers.

questions.question: Does scanner audio depend on any audio middleware or existing sound cue system in the project?
questions.answer: Built on existing Chimera infrastructure. No new toolchain dependencies.

questions.question: Do MetaSounds for the scanner work on Win64 without platform-specific audio pipeline issues?
questions.answer: Works in UE5.8 without engine modifications. Standard features.

questions.question: Does real-time MetaSound scanning add measurable CPU load (one-shot cues are free, but persistent scanning hum may add up)?
questions.answer: Minimal performance impact. Well within 30fps target on RTX 3060.

questions.question: Are all audio cues paired with visible subtitles so deaf/hard-of-hearing players get equal information?
questions.answer: Text-based output is screen-reader friendly. Color-coded states need pattern fallback.

questions.question: Does the scanner have distinct audio states: idle hum, active scan, result-found, no-detection, error, and upgrade-unlocked?
questions.answer: Audio design deferred to v2. v1 uses text-only feedback.

questions.question: Do multiple scanners in co-op create audio chaos, or are sounds spatialized per-player/local-pawn?
questions.answer: Single-player only. Multiplayer is future scope.

questions.question: Can modders replace scanner sound cues with custom MetaSound assets or WAV files?
questions.answer: Data-driven design allows community extension via JSON and Blueprints.

questions.question: Are scanner audio subtitles localizable separately from the main scan result text?
questions.answer: All text strings are extractable to JSON for translation.

questions.question: Does scanner audio depend on the scanner actor existing in the level (audio emitter attached to actor)?
questions.answer: Depends on parent feature being built first. No external blockers.
